title: Event Signature Transfer: Model-Agnostic Forecast Scenario Construction from Historical Events
abstract: arXiv:2609.23074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forecasters often know an event is imminent but not the shape, size, or timing of its effect. We introduce Event Signature Transfer (EST), a training-free, model-agnostic operator that turns a completed past event into an explicit forecast scenario. EST removes a source event's own trend and seasonality, then scales and retimes the remaining event signature onto a native forecast, preserving the forecast's linked structure and reducing to it exactly at zero strength. Because it reads only output quantiles, EST applies to any quantile forecaster, with no training, no model internals, at transfer time. Across twelve real episodes and ten synthetic scenarios on Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Toto-2.0, manually configured EST reduces real-episode WQL by 21.7-90\% in-sample. translated_title: 事件特征迁移：基于历史事件的模型无关预测场景构建
translated_abstract: 预测者往往知道某个事件即将发生，但不知道其影响的形态、规模或时机。我们提出了事件特征迁移（Event Signature Transfer, EST），这是一个无需训练、模型无关的算子，能够将一个已完成的历史事件转化为显式的预测场景。EST 首先去除源事件自身的趋势和季节性成分，然后对剩余的事件特征进行缩放和重新定时，将其叠加到原生预测之上，同时保留预测的关联结构，并在强度为零时精确退化为原预测。由于它只读取输出分位数，EST 可应用于任何分位数预测器，在迁移时无需训练、无需访问模型内部。在 Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5 和 Toto-2.0 上的十二个真实事件情景和十个合成场景中，手动配置的 EST 在样本内将真实事件情景的 WQL 降低了 21.7%–90%。在 Chronos-2 上，它在十二组对比实验中有十一组优于协变量条件化、激活编辑和原始重放方法。该算子构建的是一个预测场景，而不是……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练、模型无关的事件特征迁移算子（EST），能将已完成的历史事件转化为显式预测场景并叠加到任意分位数预测器的预测上，在多个主流预测模型的真实事件情景中将 WQL 最多降低 90%。
en_tdlr: Event Signature Transfer (EST) is a training-free, model-agnostic operator that converts completed historical events into explicit forecast scenarios, reducing WQL by 21.7–90% on real episodes across Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Toto-2.0.
